rules.description: Require a response to the current-role screener question.
Require a response to the board-certified specialty screener question.
Require a response to the primary-subspecialty screener question.
Restrict years in practice to the stated range of 0 through 99.
Terminate immediately when years in practice are below 1.
Terminate immediately when years in practice exceed 50.
Terminate at the end of the screener when years in practice are below 3.
Terminate at the end of the screener when years in practice exceed 30.
Restrict patient-treatment time to the stated range of 0 through 100 percent.
Terminate immediately when patient-treatment time is below 10 percent.
Terminate at the end of the screener when patient-treatment time is below 50 percent.
Require a response to the practice-location screener question.
Require a response to the practice-setting screener question.
Restrict the estimated inherited-retinal-disease patient count to 0 through 300.
Terminate immediately when the estimated patient count is zero.
Terminate when the estimated patient count is below 20.
Require a response to the inherited-retinal-disease management question.
Validate the multi-response format for inherited-retinal-disease types managed.
Require at least one disease-management option to be selected.
Restrict each BEST1-related patient estimate to a minimum of 0; the questionnaire specifies an upper bound based on S9.
Restrict the suspected-patient counts to 0 through 300.
Restrict BVMD management counts to 0 through 300.
Restrict ARB management counts to 0 through 300.
Restrict confirmed BVMD diagnoses to counts of zero or greater.
Restrict confirmed ARB diagnoses to counts of zero or greater.
Restrict the confidence rating to the stated scale from 1 through 7.
Restrict journey-to-diagnosis counts to zero or greater; the questionnaire specifies an upper bound based on S10a plus S10b.
Restrict professional-journey counts to zero or greater; the questionnaire specifies an upper bound based on S10a plus S10b.
Require responses for the BEST1 patient-category allocation question.
Restrict BEST1 patient-category counts to zero or greater; the questionnaire specifies an upper bound based on S10a plus S10b.
Restrict referral-source counts to zero or greater; the questionnaire specifies an upper bound based on Q5a plus Q5b.
Require responses for the BVMD disease-stage allocation question.
Restrict BVMD stage counts to zero or greater; the questionnaire specifies an upper bound based on S10a.
Require responses for the diagnostic-method allocation question.
Restrict diagnostic-method counts to zero or greater; the questionnaire specifies an upper bound based on S10a plus S10b.
Restrict each estimated proportion to 0 through 100 percent.
Require the category proportions to sum to 100 percent.
Restrict the undiagnosed-patient percentage to 0 through 99 percent.
Require a response to the diagnostic-rate comparison question.
Response is required for the undiagnosed-patient percentage estimate.
Undiagnosed-patient percentage must be between 0 and 99.
Response is required for the undiagnosed-patient percentage estimate.
Undiagnosed-patient percentage must be between 0 and 99.
All displayed unmet-need ratings must be answered.
Each unmet-need rating must be between 1 and 7.
All displayed characteristic ratings must be answered.
Each characteristic rating must be between 1 and 7.
All displayed trial-efficacy ratings must be answered.
Each trial-efficacy rating must be between 1 and 7.
The open-ended endpoint response is required.
Validate the open-ended endpoint response, which is limited to 250 characters.
Response is required for the percentage of patients addressable with Product X.
The estimated percentage must be between 0 and 100.
Q17 must be answered when S10a is greater than zero.
The open-ended description of suited BVMD patients is required.
Validate the open-ended patient-description response, which is limited to 250 characters.
Q19 must be answered when Q17 is greater than zero.
The stated recommendation count must be between 0 and 10.
Q20 must be answered when Q17 is less than S10a.
The stated recommendation count must be between 0 and 10.
Q21 must be answered when S10b is greater than zero.
The number of suited ARB patients is required.
Q23 must be answered when Q22 is greater than zero.
The stated recommendation count must be between 0 and 10.
Q24 must be answered when Q22 is below S10b and S10b is greater than zero.
The stated recommendation count must be between 0 and 10.
The open-ended explanation of limiting factors is required.
Validate the open-ended limiting-factors response, which is limited to 250 characters.
One benefit-comparison response must be selected for each therapy row.

warnings: The questionnaire supplies response labels but not coded values for the categorical screener questions, so invalid-code and option-specific screen-out rules were not emitted.

Dynamic upper bounds and allocation-total constraints referring to S9, S10a, S10b, Q1 subvariables, and Q5 subvariables were not emitted because those component variables are not supplied as canonical variables in this batch.
The S8 exclusive option is identified textually as 'None of the above', but its binary variable name is not supplied; an exclusive-variable rule was therefore not emitted.
The Q1A/Q1B/Q1C/Q1D routing conditions and Q6 applicability condition refer to component variables not supplied as canonical variables in this batch.

Dependent numeric subfields within Q19, Q20, Q23, and Q24 have questionnaire-specified dynamic upper bounds, but no separate canonical variables are supplied for those subfields; only the explicitly stated 0-10 recommendation-count range is validated.

Q26 provides therapy row labels but does not provide response-value codes or separate canonical variables for the row responses, so only the explicit one-response-per-row completion check is represented.
